description: Resampled Traffic Flow Data of Xuancheng City is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yimin Wang, Yixian Chen. resampled traffic data of Xuancheng City. - The "road_network_segment_level.csv" is the simple road network of Xuancheng. - The "fcd.csv" is the dynamic floating car data of 500 commercial vehicles in Xuancheng city. The data is collected from Sept. 1st, 2020, to Sept. 30th, 2020. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4020315298 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
